task: Bring the mockup's visual style to the existing AEO landing page and sample report while retaining the agreed product behavior.
nonGoals: Live intake or assessment, contact collection, rubric changes, enrichment, production hosting, deployment or merge.

outcomes.description: Landing uses the mockup's navy hero, peach accents, audit card, section layout and sample report entry.
outcomes.evidence: Inspect desktop and mobile rendering and sample navigation.

outcomes.description: The sample journey remains ungated, clearly synthetic and preserves the actionable report and its /100, /40 and /60 scores.
outcomes.evidence: npm run test:preview plus browser verification of navigation and report interactions.

outcomes.description: The layout remains usable on mobile and the sample journey has keyboard focus and input handling.
outcomes.evidence: Desktop and mobile keyboard and invalid-input checks.

process.description: Use an isolated feature branch, preserve scoring expectations, verify offline and obtain independent review.
process.evidence: Git ancestry, source-bound evaluation, handoff and independent review.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse existing React and rubric-backed sample data, with focused styling and no additional dependencies.

exitTest.reason: Presentation and preview behavior only. No changes to portability, memory, workflow, handoff infrastructure, or resumability.
